question: Vaidya Tara Chand Sharma, Vaidya Maya Ram Uniyal and Vaidya Sameer Govind Jamadagni were the recipients of which of the following awards in 2025?

options.text: Nelson Mandela Award for Health Promotion

solution:
The correct answer is __**National Dhanwantari Ayurveda Awards**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **National Dhanwantari Ayurveda Awards** are prestigious awards given to individuals who have made significant contributions to the field of **Ayurveda** in India.
 
• Recipients of these awards are recognized for their dedication to promoting and preserving the ancient system of Ayurveda, which is a key component of India's traditional medical heritage.
 
• In the year **2025**, **Vaidya Tara Chand Sharma**, **Vaidya Maya Ram Uniyal**, and **Vaidya Sameer Govind Jamadagni** were honored with this award for their exceptional work in the field.
 
• The award is usually conferred by the **Ministry of AYUSH**, Government of India, which is responsible for promoting Ayurveda, Yoga, Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha, and Homoeopathy.
 
• The recipients are often individuals who have contributed to **research, clinical practice, teaching, or the promotion of Ayurveda** at a national or international level.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Ayurveda:**

 
 
• Ayurveda is an ancient system of medicine that originated in **India over 5,000 years ago**.
 
• It is based on the principles of maintaining balance in the body through **diet, lifestyle, and natural remedies**.
 
• Ayurveda focuses on **holistic healing** and emphasizes the mind-body connection.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of AYUSH:**
 
 
• The **Ministry of AYUSH** (Ayurveda, Yoga & Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha, and Homoeopathy) was established in **2014** to promote traditional systems of medicine.
 
• It is responsible for the development, research, and education related to these systems of medicine.
 
 
 
• **National Dhanwantari Ayurveda Awards:**
 
 
• The award is named after **Dhanwantari**, the Hindu god of medicine and an avatar of Lord Vishnu, who is considered the father of Ayurveda.
 
• The award recognizes individuals who have made **outstanding contributions** to the research, innovation, and promotion of Ayurveda.
 
 
 
• **Other Awards in the Field of Medicine:**
 
 
• **National Florence Nightingale Awards:** These awards are conferred to outstanding **nurses and healthcare professionals**.
 
• **Nelson Mandela Award for Health Promotion:** This award recognizes contributions to **public health and health promotion** globally.
 
• **National Award to Teachers:** This award is given to educators for their **exceptional contributions to the field of education**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Eligibility for National Dhanwantari Ayurveda Awards:**

 
 
• Nominees must have demonstrated excellence in the practice, teaching, or research of Ayurveda.
 
• Their work should have a significant **impact on public health** or contribute to the advancement of Ayurveda.
 
 
 
• **Role of Ayurveda in Modern Healthcare:**
 
 
• Ayurveda is increasingly being integrated into modern healthcare systems, especially for **chronic diseases** and **preventive care**.
 
• Its emphasis on lifestyle and dietary practices aligns with modern concepts of **wellness and preventive medicine**.
